target.section: Design / Designer's calls / The code-intel route records inside the index transaction

action.newText: CodeCommitOutboxHandler does not originate an audit callback. Its process(payload, onIndexed?) forwards the optional onIndexed supplied by the subscriber as indexCommit's fifth argument, forwarding undefined when no callback is supplied.

rationale: The inspected handler currently calls indexCommit with four arguments at apps/api/src/code-intel/code-commit-outbox-handler.ts:84. That is baseline behavior; the spec's explicit target and push acceptance criteria require optional callback forwarding.
